findings.text: non-blocking: the ceiling assertion passes on the defect it is cited for. The fake clock advances 11s per read, so the names read already crosses the ceiling without the repair at imas_codex/standard_names/graph_store/graph_supersession.py:3079; measured by running this test body against a tree whose :3079 still calls find_sourceless_live_name_rows(gc, None, ...) — 1 passed in 62.11s — so the evidence page's row claiming "a test fails if that read exceeds ten seconds" is overstated and that row's repair rests on reading, not on a running guard. A discriminating test would make only the population read cross the ceiling.

non-blocking: the two suite arms' logs carry no revision header and their archive trees are gone. run3.sh reuses WORK=/tmp/sph-gate2-oRROX7, a directory no recorded extraction of this run created (scratch/gate/run2.log records work=/tmp/sph-gate2-WVJrWe and head=f62b409ba), and base.log and head.log begin at "test session starts", so a reader cannot tie the 24/24 result to a revision; the page's claim of head 71a4b606a is contradicted by the only recorded arm line, and the result survives only because the commits after f62b409ba touch docs/evidence alone — a fact read from the diff, not from the logs.

non-blocking: the widened liveness detector accepts any statement spelling "status" and "$terminal", including the inclusion form sn.status IN $terminal and any clause whose $terminal parameter holds non-terminal statuses, while the docstring at :913-916 says the parameter carries 'superseded'; the planted-query test at :975 asserts only that the recognizer fires, so nothing asserts it does not over-accept, and a restored enumeration using the inclusion form would pass the scan.
